Version 1.0.6 → 1.0.7

- Refactored all open-id (用户身份) handling to be fully automatic and internal—users never have to provide, see, or be prompted for any identity parameter.
- Updated workflow and documentation to reflect seamless user experience: no exposure of internal ID, and no user prompts related to identity.
- Simplified script usage: all identity association is handled behind the scenes; command examples no longer require open-id arguments.
- Clarified in documentation and usage that only analysis progress, results, and report links are shown to users.
- Removed or replaced previous instructions/examples that mentioned, requested, or returned any user identity value.

- Initial release of "familiar-person-recognition-analysis": Acquaintance identification in images/videos via facial comparison.
- Supports face database enrollment and recognition result annotation (who is at which location).
- Strict rules: Prohibits using any local memory/historical data except via cloud API (enforced for all report queries).
